posts.title: RGB LED earrings (36 LEDs, with microphone)
posts.description: These are new earrings, very similar to my previous 36-LED earrings but with an extra button (to make it easier to cycle through many modes) and a microphone (for audio reactivity and programming custom patterns ). Other than that, they're almost identical: same MCU, same LEDs, same PCB shape, etc. You can find the KiCad design files, source code, and instructions on how to program them on the Git
